svg.title: The Road to Rivendell
svg.desc: The Last Bridge crosses the Hoarwell west of the Bruinen. Rivendell lies northeast of the Ford, beneath the western slopes of the Misty Mountains. Original regional interpretation; north up; no numerical scale.

g.text: The Hoarwell · the Trollshaws · the Loudwater
NORTH UP · REGIONAL SCALE · THIRD AGE
